purpose: Verification run for #1289's declared behaviour-contract mechanism. Launched from a side campaign config with pass_banking_frozen=true, so it banks nothing against the default campaign; the default campaign was verified untouched before and after.
model: Qwen3-Coder-30B (deep coding), served via OpenVINO Model Server
surface: coder fleet swap driver -> OVMS -> 30B; BlarAI 14B evicted for the duration and restored after

environment.hardware: Intel Core Ultra 7 258V (Lunar Lake), Arc 140V iGPU (16GB), Intel AI Boost NPU, 32 GB LPDDR5X

methodology.note: n=1. A battery night is a single diagnostic run, not a repeated benchmark; run-to-run variance is unmeasured by construction.
methodology.gpu_headroom_at_load: 23.3 GiB free, 15 GiB required for the 30B

waves.scope_sprawl_finding: create-habit-tracking authored src/utils/analysis.js (contracted to calculate-streaks-and-success-rate) and src/utils/chart-data.js (contracted to generate-chart-data)

per_task_wall_clock_s.note: Budget elapsed mid-task. Two tasks consumed 9,403 s of a 10,800 s budget before this one started, leaving 1,397 s for a task whose two predecessors averaged 4,702 s.

behaviour_contract_observed.fix_pass_failure_mode: coder timed out on every FIX pass; pipeline kept the prior merged version
